company.source_note:
SimplexAI develops autonomous AI agents for defense and national security applications. Their agents can independently operate in digital environments to complete complex security tasks, penetration testing, and intelligence analysis. As a defense AI startup with government contracts, they face complex tech GC needs (defense contracts, ITAR compliance, export controls), AI governance for autonomous agents operating in classified environments, and potential patentable innovations in autonomous agent architectures.
